newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends slightly higher on export optimism.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends slightly higher on export optimism.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended slightly higher on Wednesday with commercial buying noted amid talk of export business, traders said.
"We've got two tenders for North and South Korea," a floor trader said. "There's definitely some business today because Dreyfus was buying."
Trade sources said Syria was looking to buy white rice. They also noted a GATT tender for South Korea and CCC tender for North Korea.
Rice ended four to two cents per cwt higher with September up two at $9.58.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 250 lots, compared with Tuesday's actual volume of 240 lots.
